questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Kavi asked Gina if French was her mother tongue.

options.text: “Whether French is your mother tongue?” Kavi asked Gina.
“Your mother tongue is French,” Kavi enquired Gina.
“French is your mother tongue,” Kavi told Gina.
“Is French your mother tongue?” Kavi asked Gina.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**“Is French your mother tongue?” Kavi asked Gina.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** option that expresses the sentence '**Kavi asked Gina if French was her mother tongue.**' in direct speech is '**“Is French your mother tongue?” Kavi asked Gina.**'
 
• **Direct speech** is *when we simply **repeat **what someone says, putting the phrase between speech marks*.__
 __
 
• **E.g.** *Paul came in and said, “I’m really hungry.”*
 
 
 
• Hence, as per the above-mentioned points, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's understand **Indirect speech**.

 
 
• *When we want to report what someone said without speech marks and **without necessarily using exactly the same words**, we can use indirect speech (also called reported speech).*__

 
 
• **E.g.** **Direct speech**: *“We’re quite cold in here.”*

 **Indirect speech**: *They say (that) they’re cold.*

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**fallacy, subservient, symbiotic**".

• **Example**: *The belief that the corner house is haunted is a** fallacy.** *
 
 
 
• **Subservient** means **acting as subordinate**.
 
 
• **Example:** *Even though Willy is talented, he acts as a ****subservient*.** 
 
 
 
• **Symbiotic** means **dependence on each other equally**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tina and her friend share a **symbiotic** relationship. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "fallacy, subservient, symbiotic". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They propose to build a dam for irrigation purposes

options.text: Build a dam for irrigation purposes.
For the irrigation purposes a dam has been built.
It is proposed to build a dam for irrigation purposes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"It is proposed to build a dam for irrigation purposes."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence given in the question is an *active voice in a simple present tense*__ *__(Subject+ first form of verb+ object).__*
 
• If the active sentence starts with ‘People think/acknowledge/know/consider/understand/believe/find/say/report/claim/**propose**....that he is’, it can be changed into passive form in two different ways.
 
• Use the dummy subject “it”:
 __
 
• It was thought..... It was written.....
 
• It was said..... It was declared.....
 
 
 
• The subject of the noun clause in the active sentence is used as the subject of the passive form.
 
 
• Besides this ‘to’ is used.
 
 

​Hence, from the above explanation, we can say that the correct sentence is:*** "It is proposed to build a dam for irrigation purposes."***

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

‘People say’ is replaced by ‘It is said’:

 
• Example:
 
• *People believed that the earth was flat. (active)*
 
• *The earth was believed to be flat. (passive)*
 
• *It was believed that the earth was flat. (passive)*
